title: Telemetry seqno coordinator and soft contract resilience
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a SeqNo-based coordination layer and a soft contract resilience mechanism for usage event ingestion to improve ordering guarantees, safe out-of-order reconciliation, and graceful schema drift handling for the Console analytics pipeline. This ticket covers the backend service changes, schema compatibility strategies, migration plan for existing producers, and observability additions (dashboards and alerts).
acceptance_criteria: New seqno coordinator service accepts batched events and assigns stable sequence tokens within 99.9% of requests under P50 < 15ms for regular load
Out-of-order events are detected and routed to a reconciliation queue with <0.1% false positives on production trace sample
Schema drift handling: unknown fields are persisted in a blob field and surfaced to schema-health dashboard; strict validation only applied after a 48-hour quarantined canary window
No dropped events during rollout when switching producers from old ingestion endpoint to new coordinator (canary traffic simulated)
End-to-end tests and a migration runbook exist and are validated by the Platform team
tasks: Design seqno assignment and idempotency keys (proto + doc)
Implement seqno coordinator microservice (Go) behind existing ingest API
Add reconciliation queue and worker to handle out-of-order ranges
Enhance schema validator to write unknown fields to raw_blob and to emit schema-health telemetry
Create feature flag + canary rollout path in Console for producers
Add dashboards: seqno-latency, reconciliation-rate, schema-health index
Run staged migration with two low-traffic customers and validate
Document rollback steps and add a smoke test to CI
